title: 16952 - 16952/P0568/001384
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Signal Wire from Steering Column Control Module (J527) OR Central Electronics Control Module (J519) to Engine Kontrol Modülü / Elektronik Beyin (ECU/TCM) Donanımsal Arızalı
Steering Column Control Module (J527) Coding faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Signal Wire from Steering Column Control Module (J527) OR Central Electronics Control Module (J519) to Engine Control Module
Kontrol edin:  Steering Column Control Module (J527) Coding
technicalNotes:
In most recent Models the Cruise Control is part of the Steering Column Control Module (J527) while in earlier ones it is Part of the Central Electronics Control Module (J519). Very early ones run the Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri directly from the Stalk/Switch to the Engine Control Module. If in doubt, Kontrol edin: the Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri Diagram for Details.
When retrofitting Cruise Control, the Signal Wire from the Steering Column Control Module (J527) OR Central Electronics Control Module (J519) to the Engine Control Module is often not being added.
